value_chain.value_chain_position: OVHcloud is Europe's largest cloud infrastructure provider, positioned as a sovereign alternative to US hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP). It operates across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS layers, offering bare metal servers, public cloud (OpenStack-based), private cloud, managed Kubernetes, GPU compute for AI, and managed databases. Upstream, it depends on hardware suppliers (NVIDIA for GPUs, Intel/AMD for CPUs) but uniquely manufactures its own servers and water-cooling systems in-house, giving it more vertical control than typical cloud providers. Downstream, it serves 1.6 million customers including startups, SMEs, enterprises, and public sector organizations across Europe. Its SecNumCloud-certified offerings specifically target customers requiring EU data sovereignty guarantees that US providers cannot match due to the CLOUD Act.

key_products: Public Cloud & Bare Metal: OpenStack-based public cloud with virtual instances, bare metal dedicated servers, block/object storage, managed Kubernetes (CNCF-certified), and load balancers. OVHcloud operates 43+ data centers across 9 countries on 4 continents, hosting 500,000+ servers. Differentiator: transparent per-hour pricing with no egress fees, significantly lower cost than hyperscalers for predictable workloads.

AI & GPU Cloud: Portfolio of NVIDIA GPU instances (H100, H200 NVL, L4, L40S) for AI training and inference. Includes AI Notebooks, AI Training, and AI Deploy (serverless tools for the full ML lifecycle). Partnership with SambaNova for ultra-low latency inference (OVHcloud AI EndPoint). GPU instances integrate natively with Managed Kubernetes. Minute-by-minute billing.

SecNumCloud Sovereign Cloud Platform (SNC): ANSSI SecNumCloud 3.2 certified cloud platform providing the highest level of French/EU data sovereignty guarantees. Protects against extraterritorial laws (US CLOUD Act). IaaS components (VMs, dedicated servers, block/object storage) available early 2026; managed Kubernetes, databases, and AI services by end 2026. Targets public sector, healthcare, finance, and defense.

business.revenue_or_valuation: FY2025 revenue: EUR 1.085B (up 9.3% YoY like-for-like), crossing the billion-euro mark for the first time. Market cap: ~EUR 1.48B / ~$1.83B (Euronext Paris: OVH.PA, as of Jan 2026). IPO in Oct 2021 at EUR 3.48B market cap, stock has declined significantly since. CEO Octave Klaba returned as CEO and set EUR 2B revenue target (timeline unspecified). FY2026 guidance: 5-7% organic revenue growth, which disappointed the market.
business.annual_recurring_revenue_arr: Not reported as a single ARR figure. Subscription-like recurring revenue model with 105% net revenue retention rate (FY2025, like-for-like). 1,200+ customers generating >EUR 100K ARR each. SecNumCloud segment: EUR 24M ARR (up 63% YoY). Total revenue is predominantly recurring (cloud subscriptions and hosting). [uncertain]
business.funding_total_and_last_round: Public company (Euronext Paris: OVH.PA) since Oct 2021. IPO raised EUR 400M at EUR 3.48B market cap. Founded by the Klaba family (Octave Klaba remains largest shareholder). No recent private funding rounds. Current market cap ~EUR 1.48B (~$1.83B), well below IPO valuation. Company is self-funding growth through operating cash flow.
business.business_model: Usage-based and subscription cloud computing. Revenue streams: (1) IaaS compute (bare metal, virtual instances, GPU instances -- per-hour billing); (2) PaaS managed services (Kubernetes, databases, AI tools); (3) Web hosting and domain registration (legacy business, large customer base); (4) Private Cloud (dedicated infrastructure); (5) Storage (object, block, archive). Key differentiators: transparent pricing with no hidden fees, no egress charges (unlike hyperscalers), predictable costs. FY2025 adjusted EBITDA margin above 40%, demonstrating strong profitability. Unlevered free cash flow EUR 57.6M (FY2025, doubled YoY).
business.burn_rate_and_runway: Not applicable -- OVHcloud is profitable. FY2025 adjusted EBITDA margin above 40%. Unlevered free cash flow of EUR 57.6M. Capex: EUR 128.9M recurring (11.9% of revenue) + EUR 232.5M growth capex (21.4% of revenue). Self-funding operations and growth through cash flow. No burn rate concerns.

openness.open_vs_closed_spectrum: Hybrid (open-source-friendly infrastructure). OVHcloud builds on open-source technologies: OpenStack for public cloud, CNCF-certified Kubernetes, and open standards throughout. Does not develop proprietary foundation models. Promotes interoperability and portability (no vendor lock-in as a core value proposition). Founding member of GAIA-X (European data infrastructure standards) and CISPE (Cloud Infrastructure Services Providers in Europe). Open APIs and standard protocols.

startup_relevance.relevance_for_startups: OVHcloud is strategically important for European startups for several reasons: (1) EU data sovereignty compliance: For any startup handling European personal data or operating in regulated sectors (health, finance, public sector), OVHcloud's SecNumCloud certification provides compliance guarantees that US hyperscalers fundamentally cannot offer due to the CLOUD Act -- this is not a marketing claim but a legal structural difference; (2) Cost advantage: OVHcloud's pricing is typically 30-60% lower than AWS/Azure/GCP for equivalent compute, with transparent pricing and zero egress fees -- for startups with predictable workloads, this significantly extends runway; (3) GPU accessibility: NVIDIA H100/H200 instances available on-demand with minute-by-minute billing and no long-term commitments, integrated with managed Kubernetes, making it accessible for AI startups that cannot secure GPU allocations from hyperscalers; (4) No vendor lock-in: Built on OpenStack and standard Kubernetes, making it straightforward to migrate workloads to/from other providers -- critical for startups that may need to change infrastructure as they scale; (5) European regulatory alignment: As EU AI Act enforcement begins (Aug 2025 onward), hosting AI workloads on EU-sovereign infrastructure simplifies compliance for startups deploying AI in regulated contexts; (6) Startup program: OVHcloud offers a dedicated startup program with credits and technical support; (7) Market signal: For B2B startups selling to European enterprises or public sector, hosting on OVHcloud signals data sovereignty commitment, which can be a competitive advantage in procurement; (8) Vertical integration: OVHcloud manufactures its own servers and cooling systems, giving it cost structure advantages and supply chain resilience compared to pure resellers.
startup_relevance.accessibility: Highly accessible. OVHcloud Startup Program provides credits and technical support for early-stage companies. $200 free trial credits for new Public Cloud customers. Pay-as-you-go pricing with no minimum commitment. GPU instances (H100, H200, L4, L40S) available on-demand. Managed Kubernetes is free (pay only for underlying instances). Extensive documentation in English and French. API-first approach with standard OpenStack APIs. No enterprise minimum for most services. Pricing significantly below hyperscaler equivalents for comparable resources.
startup_relevance.primary_model_dependency: None. OVHcloud is infrastructure-layer and does not depend on any specific foundation model. Hosts and enables deployment of any model (open-source or proprietary). Partnership with SambaNova for inference optimization. Customers can deploy Mistral, Llama, or any other model on OVHcloud GPU instances.

ecosystem.key_partnerships: NVIDIA: GPU partnership providing H100, H200 NVL, L4, L40S instances; joint AI solutions for deep learning, inference, and HPC. SambaNova: partnership for ultra-low latency AI inference (OVHcloud AI EndPoint). GAIA-X: founding member of the European data infrastructure initiative alongside Atos, 3DS Outscale, Docaposte, and others. CISPE: founding member of Cloud Infrastructure Services Providers in Europe. ANSSI: SecNumCloud 3.2 qualification from the French national cybersecurity agency. LCH SA: cloud agreement (Nov 2025). ETHIQAIS: partnership for AI governance and EU AI Act compliance tooling. Open-source ecosystem: contributor to and user of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and related CNCF projects.
ecosystem.competitive_moat: European sovereignty positioning: Only major European cloud provider with SecNumCloud 3.2 certification (ANSSI), providing legal protection against extraterritorial data access laws (US CLOUD Act, Chinese DSL) -- a structural advantage that US hyperscalers cannot replicate regardless of their 'sovereign cloud' marketing. Vertical hardware integration: OVHcloud designs and manufactures its own servers and proprietary water-cooling systems in-house, giving it cost structure advantages (EBITDA margin >40%) and supply chain control that pure cloud resellers lack. No egress fees: A significant cost differentiator that creates switching cost advantages for data-intensive workloads. Scale in Europe: 43+ data centers across 9 countries, 500K+ servers, 1.6M customers -- the largest European-owned cloud provider, creating network effects in the European market. Regulatory alignment: Deep involvement in GAIA-X, CISPE, and EU regulatory frameworks positions OVHcloud to benefit from European digital sovereignty policies and potential procurement preferences for EU cloud providers.

regulatory.regulatory_exposure: Exempt from GPAI provider obligations (does not develop foundation models). Positioned as a beneficiary of EU AI Act: OVHcloud's SecNumCloud-certified infrastructure enables customers to meet high-risk AI system hosting requirements under the EU AI Act. Active compliance enabler through ETHIQAIS partnership for AI governance tooling. SecNumCloud 3.2 certification from ANSSI (French cybersecurity agency) provides the highest level of cloud security qualification in France/EU. GDPR compliant by design -- all data stays in EU, no exposure to US CLOUD Act or extraterritorial access. ISO 27001 certified. Founding member of CISPE and GAIA-X, actively shaping EU cloud policy.
